apps.name: Webink
apps.subtitle: One library across eleven manga sources
apps.localizedDescription:
Eleven manga sites, one library.

Webink aggregates manga sources behind a single interface and keeps your place. Trending and latest releases on the home screen, search scoped to a source or to your own library, and a shelf where every title carries a status, a ranking and a chapter position.

Progress is stored on device and syncs to the cloud once you sign in, so a new phone picks up where the old one stopped. Sign-in is optional — the app is fully usable without an account.

Webink hosts nothing. It is an interface onto content the sources already publish.
